messages:
Maya (eng-sec): ShieldCheck confirmed pen test window next Tue 09:00-17:00 UTC. They've asked for scope confirmation, RBAC access for a small set of service accounts, and a way to pull audit logs and KMS-wrapped artifacts. Can we lock answers by EOD today? @jon @lia :calendar:
Jon (infra): +1. High-level: we should not hand over long-lived KMS keys. We can create an ephemeral IAM role that allows DescribeKey + GenerateDataKeyWithPlaintext for a dedicated key alias. Recommend time-boxed STS creds and CloudTrail exports to a secure evidences bucket. 
Lia (sre): For logs: we can produce a 7-day rolling CloudTrail/CWL export and a separate VPC flow log snapshot for the affected projects. Need to know which environments are in-scope (staging vs prod). Also: retention for exported evidence? do they need hashes?
Maya (eng-sec): Scope: staging + canary prod only. We will not allow interactive prod console access. They requested proof of fixes after remediation and a retest window within 2 weeks of fixes. We should require SHA256 checksums on uploaded evidence. 
Sam (platform): I'll stand up an S3 evidence bucket with enforced encryption and MFA delete disabled for the vendor-upload path. Plan: presigned PUT URLs that expire after 1h and a signed manifest containing filenames + SHA256. We'll rotate the presigned URL signing key per-day. 
Jon (infra): IAM policy sketch for ephemeral role (for vendor): 
``` 
{ 
  "Version": "2012-10-17", 
  "Statement": [ 
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"], "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/pen-test/vendor-ephemeral" }, 
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey*","kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/pen-test-evidence-key" } 
  ] 
} 
```
But we should scopedown to GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext and let the platform rewrap artifacts; avoid kms:Decrypt where possible. Need sign-off from security.
Maya (eng-sec): Agreed — prefer Encrypt-only flow: vendor uploads encrypted blob and we (platform) decrypt once for triage if needed. That removes need for direct Decrypt perms. @sam can you add a rewrap step?
Sam (platform): Yep. Flow: vendor uploads AES-GCM encrypted payload (client-side) + manifest. Platform runs a verification job that rewraps the envelope key under our evidence KMS key using ReEncrypt pattern. We'll provide a single-use decryption token to triage team. I can add a small lambda to verify SHA256 and move to /evidence/locked.
Lia (sre): For audit trails, we need immutable records: CloudTrail + S3 Object Lock (compliance mode) for the final evidence set. We can't Object Lock vendor temp uploads, only after we verify. Will add lifecycle policy to move verified objects to locked prefix and set retention 90 days.
Maya (eng-sec): Good. Action items: 
1) @jon create ephemeral role + kms alias and post IAM ARNs by EOD
2) @sam create presigned upload flow + verification lambda and doc for manifest format
3) @lia export sample CloudTrail + VPC flow logs and share S3 path
4) eng-sec will create a remediation tracking board in Linear and assign owners
Jon (infra): I'll put role and key up in infra repo under `infra/pen-test/` and create a short playbook in the PR. Quick snippet: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/pen-test/vendor-ephemeral --duration-seconds 3600`
Maya (eng-sec): Remediation/tracking: we want per-finding tickets with expected fix ETA + verification steps. After fixes, vendor requests retest slot — recommend offering 3 retest slots within 14 days. Keep retest to low-impact smoke tests where possible.
Sam (platform): I'll document manifest schema: `filename, sha256, size_bytes, upload_ts, evidence_type` and a sample presigned PUT curl example. Will also add a short test harness so ShieldCheck can do a dry-run upload tomorrow.
Lia (sre): Operational guardrails: throttle vendor API calls to 5 req/s to our verification lambda, set alarm if >500 5xxs in 10m. Also make sure logs from verification lambda go to restricted workspace with retention 180 days.
Maya (eng-sec): One more: incident response linkability. We need POC mapping from vendor findings -> internal incident IDs. We'll require vendor to include a unique evidence_id in manifest that maps to Linear ticket. 
Jon (infra): Noted. Also recommending ephemeral RBAC mapping: vendor-role only allowed to assume from vendor IP CIDR via condition: `aws:SourceIp` — will add to role.
Maya (eng-sec): OK timeline: finalize infra + platform work today, dry-run upload tomorrow morning, vendor test Tuesday 09:00 UTC. Retest window target: within 14 days after our verification and fix deployment. I'll create Linear board and add checklist.
sec-bot: Note: PenTest request logged: PEN-2026-042. Link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PEN-2026-042
Jon (infra): PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/423 — contains IAM role + KMS alias. Please review.
Sam (platform): Dry-run checklist posted: https://docs.internal.redwood/evidence/pen-test-upload
Maya (eng-sec): Thanks team. We'll do a 30m sync at 16:00 to confirm EOD items. :thumbsup:
